annotations.title: GDP by country, World Bank data: current US$, real growth and per capita

description: GDP of any country from World Bank data: GDP in current US dollars, annual real GDP growth in % and GDP per capita in US dollars, for the last 1-10 years with the newest year first. Country by ISO code (SE, SWE) or English name. Read from a committed World Bank Open Data snapshot (CC BY 4.0), so every call answers at once; the snapshot date is in the answer. Use for country comparisons, market sizing and macro context. Example: country=SE. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
